ticket.title: The meta-harness root has no git remote: the canonical ledger, archive and config exist only on one machine
acceptance_criteria: DUPLICATE of GB-155
archived 2026-11-06. GB-155 is the epic that owns this: 'Cut the meta-harness suite release: pre-release checklist
suite.lock
root changelog and certified snapshot tag'
whose step 4 is push. This ticket is folded into it.\n\nThe one fact worth carrying over
because it means GB-155 step 4 cannot currently execute: the root has NO remote and the GitHub repository does not exist. git remote -v is empty on the meta-harness
and git ls-remote git@github.com:gaugeblock/neurosymbolic-suite.git returns 'Repository not found' - authentication succeeds (members push over SSH fine) so the repo itself is absent
not inaccessible.\n\nRoot hygiene checked while investigating and is clean: no tracked .env
no miter.redb
no .sqlite
no target/; largest tracked file is the 1.4MB canonical ledger
then the 35KB ledger archive and design plans. So the root is in a reasonable state to publish once a destination exists.
